title: Religious grandparents disapproved of his music
summary: His father played in a brass band but not trumpet; his religious grandparents disliked music, so he played in halls and at other people's houses.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, then having a father that played instruments helped though, didn't it?
That's right. But you see, he didn't play no trumpet, you see?
What, what do you think about you taking up the trumpet? Oh, he liked it, that.
My grandfather didn't approve of it at all. Why? Oh, no, he religious.
I couldn't even play my horn around the house. Well, now why, I thought, I thought this music had such a part in religion. Why didn't?
No, no, he didn't like that. My grandfather, my grandma, they didn't like music.
What did they say when you were playing?

I used to leave and go play my, go in them halls in different places, go to other people's houses and go on. It didn't stop me at all. I just kept, I just continued going, you know what I mean? So, when I found myself, well, I was down here.
